title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the electric field E in terms of B0, a, and w.

title: Propagation Speed
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the speed of propagation v as c.

title: Generation Method
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide a coherent explanation of how the field can be generated, including the concept of total reflection.

title: Maxwell's Equation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct application of Maxwell's equations to derive E from B.

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the calculations.
